title: D3 SCRIPT output (fetch_passages.py)
description: Section 12/D3 'Writes' line: steps/D3/out/<QID>.json with three lists: latest, older, lab_manual. D3 is a pure SCRIPT step (no agent, spec 12/D3 Worker line) -- no error/oneOf branch is needed the way agent-output schemas have one, since fetch_passages.py never writes {"error": ...} (a genuinely missing/broken D3 input is a hard Python exception surfaced as a non-zero exit code per scripts/CONVENTIONS.md rule 2, not a shape this schema needs to describe). Created as part of the D1-D4 runner-plugin build (2026-10), replacing the empty placeholder schema file.

latest.description: Latest-edition passages linked to the question's D2 subtopic(s) (step a), ranked by word-trigram overlap with stem+answer and truncated to 15 when there were more.

older.description: Older-edition partners of the latest passages above, from A6's ncert/pairs/<CHAPTER>.json (step b), PLUS every older-edition passage of the same chapter(s) not paired to any latest passage -- possible deleted content (step c). Both feed this one combined list per spec 12/D3's three-list Writes shape. Empty when A6 never ran for this chapter -- a real, honest gap for every chapter this build has real data for (see report), not an error.

lab_manual.description: Lab-manual passages whose words match the question, Physics/Chemistry only (step d). Always empty for a Biology question.
